The 'grip' specific images often lack the full context to verify all contact points.

mesh_landmarks.explanation: Selected VIEW 2 as it clearly shows the full profile of the axe head and handle, with the sharp cutting edge facing left and the handle extending downward. handle_butt is placed at the very bottom tip of the wooden haft, visible as the dark, textured end. grip_center is located on the mid-section of the handle, where the wood grain and leather wrapping are visible, indicating the primary palm grip. working_head is centered on the metal head’s body, just above the blade’s curve. functional_edge is placed precisely on the outermost visible point of the curved, sharpened blade edge, clearly distinct from the working_head and facing outward, not toward the poll or handle. All points lie on visible textured material, not background or grid.
